# Troolify

> Online tools hub by F9XR Team — free, fast, 100% client-side web utilities.

Every Troolify tool runs entirely in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

## Tools
- [Word Counter](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/text/word-counter.html): Live word, character, sentence and reading-time stats.
- [JSON Formatter](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/coding/json-formatter.html): Format, validate, minify and copy JSON instantly.
- [YouTube Timestamp Link Generator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/youtube/timestamp-link-generator.html): Clickable timestamp links and instant video-description chapters.
- [Song Length Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/audio/song-length-calculator.html): Calculate exact track runtime from BPM and bar repetitions.

## Catalog
- [Utility Catalog](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/index.html): Browse every category and tool.
